description: Find tokenized real-estate listings across RealT, Lofty, Binaryx and Reental. Filter by platform, country, text, payout status or recent trading. Each row has the last traded price, issue price, yield with its basis, payout status and caveats.

include_exited.description: Include sold/redeemed and unlisted listings. Default false.

payout_status.description: regular = distributions arriving on schedule; stalled = overdue; not_started = not yet paying (e.g. under construction).

platform.description: Limit to one platform. Omit for all four.

query.description: Text matched against the address/title and location, e.g. 'Detroit' or 'Chase St'.

sort.description: Default last_trade (most recently traded first). 'yield' ranks listings whose distributions are being paid first, then those that are not, then off-plan projections.

traded_within_days.description: Only listings with an executed trade in this many days.

name: search_properties
title: Search tokenized properties
